ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is at the top of the food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: At the very top of the image is a large animal, labeled beside it as “Baleen whale”. Below it is a smaller organism, labeled as “Krill”. At the very bottom is “Phytoplankton”. An arrow points upward from Phytoplankton to Krill, and then from Krill upward to Baleen whale. Reasoning: Reading the food chain from bottom to top, the order is Phytoplankton → Krill → Baleen whale. Therefore, the one located at the top of the food chain is baleen whale.
